_README: Dated compliance-programme duties, filed as lead-time Asana reminder tasks by scripts/compliance-calendar.mjs (weekly Compliance Calendar workflow). Two shapes: one-off { id, title, date, leadDays } and recurring { id, title, anchor, everyMonths, leadDays } — recurring occurrences are computed from the anchor, month-end clamped. Optional on both: graceDays (default 7 — a weekly cron straddling the date still files, late but loudly), provisional: true (an external body sets the date; the task tells the owner to confirm it), owner, notes[]. A duty is due inside [occurrence − leadDays, occurrence + graceDays]; each occurrence is filed once, deduped by exact task title (which embeds the occurrence date). EDIT THIS FILE to move a provisional date or add duties the repository cannot know (EWRA refresh anniversary, goAML registration renewal, licence renewals) — never the workflow.
